reason: As a skeptical fixed-income homeowner, I'd trust A more. It's upfront ("I want to be straight with you"), gives the full yearly cost of $122 as well as about $10 a month, and answers the "blank check" worry with a concrete cap of $2.3M a year for two named uses. B shrinks the cost to "33 cents a day" and claims "many of the people who use this branch are retirees," which isn't in the facts.
